tested_behaviors: Missing values, NaN, inconsistent units and category/value lengths are rejected.
Source-rounded survey totals are preserved rather than normalized.
Wide and annotation-rail variants retain the same source data.
Visible horizontal category order follows the canonical source order.
Shared-scale small multiples use a common percentage range and ticks.
Changed chart caches, wrong workbooks, external ranges and stale source/artifact hashes block verification.
Empty, failed, contradictory and incomplete check reports do not authorize delivery.
limits: Private regression reports, source data and generated acceptance decks are not distributed here.
The downloadable public demos preserve the previously accepted design and use synthetic data.
Manual editing inside Microsoft PowerPoint and WPS was not tested.
Other authoring runtimes need separate adaptation and validation.
Automated checks do not prove source extraction accuracy, analytical interpretation or visual quality.
